_readme: Fourth read of Mt. San Antonio College's maps (S345, SkyLantern). Read 3 (run 37810862182) found the source: the Guided Pathways list (www.mtsac.edu/guided-pathways/filter_listings_mtsac_all.php, 455 programs) links each program's 'Guided Pathways for Success' suggested sequence, a page per program keyed by the college's local program code (pathway-results.html?pthwyvar=<code>). The pilot's programs match by the code the catalog prints in each program's title: Fire Technology certificate 03086 is N0486 (read in run 37810862182), Early Childhood Education AS-T 33876 is S0401, and the LVN-to-RN A.S. 08086 is S0957, which the list does not carry (it lists an older S1201). This read loads S0401's page.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses, read on one map the index links.
